why: Skill archify - diagramas arquitetura, workflow, sequence, data-flow e lifecycle. O opencode carrega via symlink em ~/.config/opencode/skills/archify -> ~/.agents/skills/archify.

Skill browser-harness - controle direto do browser via CDP para automacao, scraping, testes e interacao web. O opencode carrega via symlink em ~/.config/opencode/skills/browser-harness -> ~/.agents/skills/browser-harness.
